name: inspira-animated-tabs
title: Animated Tabs
description: A rounded tab bar whose highlight springs from label to label, above a large gradient card that changes colour with the chosen tab. Inactive cards sit stacked behind at reduced size.
use: A few content panels share one spot and the switch between them should feel physical.
avoid: Panels are absolutely stacked, so the wrapper needs an explicit height or the cards collapse.
a11y: Labels are real buttons, but they carry no tab role or aria-selected and the panels never use aria-hidden. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A pill-shaped dark bar holds three short text labels, one sitting on a white capsule. Below a wide gap, a big rounded gradient card carries an emoji, a bold title and a small subtitle; its colour follows the tab.
behaves: Clicking a label springs the capsule to it and brings that card forward while the others shrink and tuck behind. On pointer enter the stacked cards fan upward by fifty pixels each.
customise: tabs supplies a title, value and content node per tab; value, defaultValue and onValueChange drive selection, and three className props restyle bar, pill and panel.
weight: light: One shared-layout pill and at most three spring-animated panels mounted at once.
demo: Tabs Home, About and Work; panels hold a house, wave or briefcase emoji with a matching heading and sentence.
issues: Inactive panels stay in the page behind the active card, so hidden text is still exposed to screen readers.
In frames 1 and 3 the emoji sits on top of the panel heading instead of above it.
polishWhy: Crisp sliding pill and tidy stacked cards; the emoji and heading collide in some frames.
